notes: Pass 1 (CWE-22/23/36/73 Path Traversal) labeling of pyLoad 0.5.0b3 / pyload-ng (pyload_vuln source tree, 44581 baseline LOC, CodeQL DB pyload-db nested inside the tree and excluded from all labeling evidence).

Labeling performed by the in-session LLM itself (glm-5.3 via Claude Code CLI) in 7 logical batches (pass1-s1..s3 source families, pass1-k1..k4 sink families) after first-hand source reading of the webui blueprints (app/api/cnl/json), webui/app/helpers.py, core/api/__init__.py, core/utils/{fs,purge,parse,old}.py, core/datatypes/{pypackage,pyfile}.py, plugins/base/{downloader,extractor,container,plugin,captcha,ocr}.py, plugins/addons/{ExtractArchive,Checksum,AntiVirus,UpdateManager,HotFolder,ExternalScripts,MergeFiles}.py, plugins/extractors/{UnTar,UnZip,HjSplit,SevenZip,UnRar}.py, core/network/http/*, plugins/containers/*, plugin_manager/config/account_manager/database_thread/log_factory and the torrent decrypters; no external LLM API calls were made.

Dedup policy: candidates merged on (file, line, callable, flowKind, argIndex, receiver) per CSV (4 exact-duplicate source rows and 7 exact-duplicate sink rows collapsed); the 6 Api definition rows extracted in BOTH csvs (set_config_value, add_package, check_online_status_container, set_package_name, upload_container, set_package_data) merge into single source entries (the parameter is the taint boundary; downstream propagation is carried by the path_join/summary entries).

Sources were accepted only at true input boundaries: Flask request reads (args/form/values/auth/items/files/filename), route variables, the RPC-receiving core Api parameters, and remote archive entry names. sys.argv and argparse fields are operator-trust and labeled none/fp; an internal function parameter is NOT auto-labeled source (filemanager(path) at app_blueprint.py:439 was discarded because its route declares no variable).

Sinks were accepted only for actual file read/write/delete/extract/serve operations (open, io.open, FileStorage.save, send_from_directory, extractall, extractor Popen destination, remove/rmdir/rmtree/move/copy/chmod/makedirs at reduced confidence for mutations, listdir/stat as 0.45-0.55 candidate oracles). os.path.join/normpath/realpath/relpath/basename were labeled summary (taint-preserving propagation, NOT sinks), except where the call IS the guard (UnTar commonprefix, torrent-decrypter startswith checks) or the neutralizer (parse.name basename).

Sanitizers labeled only with concrete verified evidence: purge.name (separator removal, PyFile._set_name pyfile.py:33-34, http_chunk.py:349), parse.name basename (parse.py:45/47), add_package folder strip (api/__init__.py:427-438, noted on the add_package entries), CNL dlc separator strip (cnl_blueprint.py:93-94, on the entry), HjSplit basename (:57), http_request FormFile basename (:252), ZDF basename (:60). safepath/safename (core/utils/old/__init__.py:36/71) are labeled PARTIAL sanitizers (candidate): they remove in-component separators and drive letters but PRESERVE '..' as a standalone component on posix - this is the load-bearing weakness of the PyPackage.folder chain.

Key taint chains carried into the labels: (1) /json/add_package multipart file.filename -> join(storage,'tmp_'+filename) -> file.save (json_blueprint.py:148-157) - unsanitized filename retains separators so 'x/../../evil' traverses; the 'tmp_' prefix only blocks a leading bare '..' component. (2) Api.upload_container/check_online_status_container filename/container -> open(join(storage,'tmp_'+name),'wb') (api/__init__.py:535/951) - same shape, RPC-reachable with ADD permission. (3) /json/edit_package pack_folder -> Api.set_package_data setattr '_folder' -> PyPackage.folder (safepath, dotdot components preserved) -> downloader makedirs/open (downloader.py:319-322, http_chunk.py:183/208), ExtractArchive extract destinations (ExtractArchive.py:239-255 -> UnZip/UnTar/SevenZip/UnRar/HjSplit), MergeFiles/XDCC/YoutubeCom/Checksum/AntiVirus joins. (4) /files/get/<path> -> unquote+replace('..','') -> send_from_directory (app_blueprint.py:161-165) - werkzeug safe_join (external to the DB) is the load-bearing guard. (5) pathchooser request path -> normpath/isdir/realpath/listdir (app_blueprint.py:257-308) - intentional directory browser, STATUS-auth, labeled candidate. (6) remote archive entry names -> UnZip extractall (stdlib-guarded), UnTar _safe_extractall (commonprefix guard, char-prefix weakness), SevenZip/UnRar Popen dest. (7) torrent package-name tmp writes in the decrypters (raw package name, safejoin keeps dotdot components).

Per the experimental contract, no ground truth (CVE_VULNERABILITY_REPORT.md, CVE_Application_Report_Unassigned.md, VULNERABILITY_AUDIT_REPORT.md, path_traversal_sinks.csv at the repo root), patch diffs or CVE data were consulted; only the pyload source tree was read. No source files, CodeQL databases, Augur assets or Phase 1 CSVs were modified.
